resources.string: Makes the keypad\'s top-left key Back (hold it for the phone)
Turns the top-left key of the Sidephone keypad into a Back key in every app. Holding it opens the phone app. SideKit only watches that one key; it does not read the screen or anything you type.
Shows apps you add to Sideport in Sidekit\'s design

Sideport opens the Android apps you add to it as Sidekit apps. While one of those apps is open, Sideport reads what is on its screen and redraws it with Sidekit\'s lists and action bar, and presses the app\'s buttons and types into its fields for you. It reads nothing while no Sideport app is open, and nothing leaves the phone.
